status_legend.docs-only: Advertised in a guide but implementation not located; do not present as working.
status_legend.existing: UI and/or documented implementation exists in audited source; not all paths exercised live.
status_legend.fork: Our custom implementation; preserve its semantics.
status_legend.host: Implemented but requires ComfyUI APIs, node support, browser or OS capabilities.
status_legend.optional: Implemented optional AI/compute capability; prerequisites and degraded states mandatory.
status_legend.backend: Backend/client capability found; dedicated UI not located or not established in this audit.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Watch all character GENERATIONS roots at once
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: Current watcher_scope.py resolves output or one custom root. Multiple registered roots do not mean simultaneous watchers.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Auto-discover new <trigger>/GENERATIONS directories
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: No verified glob-root discovery contract. Register existing real directories in current product.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Unified task-centered shell and command routing
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: Recompose existing library, viewer, workflows and operations surfaces; navigation proposal is not existing route structure.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Persistent saved filter rules and dynamic collections
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: Smart ideas/clustering exist; a general automatically refreshed saved-query engine was not established.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Global undo, trash browser or editing history
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: Do not promise restoration for delete/rename/move; inspect concrete backend operations before designing undo.

gaps_and_non_goals.title: Full media editor, cloud sync, team accounts, model marketplace
gaps_and_non_goals.reason: Not established product capabilities; viewer adjustments and save nodes are not a general editor or cloud DAM.
